It was not "the Boston Globe" that referred to Baumgartner thus, it was a specific columnist, Kevin Cullen, as evidenced by the citation. Cullen called Baumgartner an architect of hope due to his focus on what the U.S. was doing well in Iraq, as opposed to officials from the Bush White House who were blaming each other for getting into Iraq in the first place.
